# Oshawa Heating & Cooling

> Oshawa Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Oshawa, Durham Region, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 721-3485  |  Email: contact@oshawaheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://oshawaheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Oshawa, Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Bowmanville, Newcastle, Courtice, Port Hope
